retrieval.reason: Not permitted. Before this review, df -h / reported Avail 12Gi (12680000 KiB blocks, about 12.1 GiB), below the 18 GiB reserve, so a download would not leave disk above the reserve. No request was sent. The repo names public NASA endpoints and product citations, but it does not document a specific permitted license for a new download: docs/product-quality/PROVIDER_FEDERATION_STATUS.md lists the NASA license only as "NASA open", and docs/NASA_EARTH_SYSTEMS_INTEGRATION.md lists citations without redistribution terms.
